Harpers Switching Station carried CVOW's first power to the grid on March 23, 2026; Dominion's Q3 2026 10-Q says onshore construction for first power was completed December 2025 and the rest substantially completed October 2026. CVOW first power delivered through Harpers on March 23, 2026.

Dominion completed the three overhead 230 kV circuits Fentress - Harpers in June 2025 and CVOW delivered first power over them on March 23, 2026 (Q3 2026 10-Q: onshore construction for first power done Dec 2025). CVOW first power to the grid on March 23, 2026.

The CTPC August 2026 mid-year update to the 2025 Collaborative Transmission Plan changed DEP project E230124 (Lilesville - Oakboro 230 kV Black & White rebuild) to status Underway with a 12/1/2028 in-service date; the DEC portion W230323 is Planned for 6/1/2028.
The CTPC 2025-2035 Collaborative Transmission Plan (Apr 2026) and its Aug 2026 update list E190092 Greenville - VEPCO Everetts 230 kV reconductor as Underway, in service 12/1/2026.

PNM filed its CCN application with the NM PRC on Oct 30, 2026 for the 102.8-mile Mid-State 345 kV project (Western Spirit Switching Station - Hidden Mountain), with in-service by end of 2029 and a requested final order by July 30, 2027; it is now a utility project with a pending application rather than only proposed.

Orsted says Sunrise Wind's Holbrook onshore converter and export cables are finished and the project expects commercial operation in the second half of 2027 (Newsday, Sept/Oct 2026; NYSERDA CES report July 2026: onshore work 100% complete, full commissioning 2027).

Equinor said in Oct 2026 that Empire Wind 1 first power slips into early 2027 with turbine installation starting 2027 and commercial operation expected in 2027; the SBMT onshore substation was expected to be energized in fall 2026.

drop.pjms-pjm-east-njcec-east-windsor-smithbu: This is NJ SAA project b3737.29 (East Windsor - Smithburg E2005 conversion to 500/230 kV); it is on Schedule 1 (canceled) of the NJ BPU-PJM Mutual Termination Agreement, approved by NJ BPU April 22, 2026 and accepted by FERC June 22, 2026 (ER26-2294), and PJM's Board removed it from the RTEP.
drop.pjms-pjm-east-njcec-clarksville-lawrence: NJ SAA project b3737.27 (rebuild ~0.8 mi of D1018 Clarksville - Lawrence 230 kV) is on Schedule 1 (canceled) of the SAA Mutual Termination Agreement accepted by FERC June 22, 2026.
drop.pjms-pjm-east-njcec-clarksville-windsor-: The Windsor - Clarksville SAA subproject (b3737.59) is on Schedule 1 (canceled) of the NJ SAA Mutual Termination Agreement; only b3737.1, .38, .39, .45, .47 and .60 remain in the RTEP.
drop.pjms-pjm-east-njcec-middlesex-red-oak-23: The Northern NJ SAA reconductoring projects (b3737.31 Lake Nelson I - Middlesex, b3737.33/.34 Red Oak A/B - Raritan River, b3737.55 Middlesex) are on Schedule 1 (canceled) of the SAA Mutual Termination Agreement accepted by FERC June 22, 2026.
drop.sppr-tsok-redbud-mathewson-345: Withdrawn: SPP's board withdrew the $72M Mathewson - Redbud 345 kV line (Transource, Piedmont to Luther, OK) on Nov 17, 2026 after re-evaluation found not building it gave more benefit at lower cost. https://www.kosu.org/energy-environment/2026-11-18/electric-grid-operator-withdraws-72-million-transmission-line-planned-for-central-oklahoma ; https://www.kgou.org/energy/2026-11-18/electric-grid-operator-withdraws-72-million-transmission-line-planned-for-central-oklahoma
